description: What the game executable needs from the Inventory menu SWF. Required flags from spike S-B (TEST-IN-GAME-0.5.md, S-B results, SE 1.7.104, 2026-10-27; logs spike-logs/S-B-*.log): each run left one group out of a working replacement. Entries with proof "source" come from the decompiled vanilla and SkyUI SWFs (draft: Inkwell-Spec/spikes/inventory-contract/inventory.contract.draft.json) and were not seen in the S-B logs.

sources.in-game: spike S-B runs A0-A6, B0, C0 and variant 7 (owner, SE 1.7.104)
sources.vanilla: interface/inventorymenu.swf from Skyrim - Interface.bsa, game 1.7.104, decompiled with FFDec 26.3.0 (not stored)

entries.evidence: S-B A1: without it the game crashes (null read in SkyrimSE.exe+0CF5AAB) when the menu opens.
entries.notes: Returns the item list object; the engine fills its entryList and reads its selectedIndex.

entries.evidence: S-B A3: without the clip the game crashes (same address, other path); the log ends at the lookup of _root.Menu_mc.
S-B A5: without the ExternalInterface callbacks no engine->as callback arrives at all (dead list, equip, drop, card); the engine looks up _root.call.
entries.notes: ExternalInterface.addCallback("call", ...) on the root timeline, as gfx.io.GameDelegate.initialize does. Every callback entry below arrives through it.

entries.evidence: S-B A5 (see fn.bridge.call); the engine looks up _root.respond. The item card info arrives through it (respond uid=n {...}) as the answer to RequestItemCardInfo.
The engine reads it in every run ("engine used list.entryList get") and fills it with the items; never left out in S-B, so whether its absence crashes is not known.
entries.notes: Entry fields seen in game: text, count, enabled, equipState, filterFlag, favorite.

entries.evidence: S-B A6: with every list member except entryList left out the menu shows, but equip, drop and the card are dead; the engine reads list.selectedIndex for the item it acts on.
S-B A2: works without it (the engine calls it when present).
S-B A2: works without it (the engine calls it when present). Platform 0 = PC.
S-B: the engine looks it up ("lookup of missing _root.BackgroundAlpha") and works without it.
entries.notes: Type is a guess from the name.

entries.name: SetCategoriesList
entries.evidence: Seen in every S-B run when the menu opens; flag 0 marks a divider.
entries.notes: Without a handler the category list stays empty (inferred).

entries.name: InvalidateListData
entries.evidence: Seen in S-B after the engine (re)filled entryList (open, equip, drop).
entries.notes: Without a handler the list never redraws (inferred).

entries.name: UpdatePlayerInfo
entries.evidence: Seen in S-B. Fields seen: health, maxHealth, magicka, maxMagicka, stamina, maxStamina, shoutPoints, maxShoutPoints, encumbrance, maxEncumbrance, armor, damage, gold, dragonSoulText, healthColor, magickaColor, staminaColor.

entries.name: RestoreIndices
entries.evidence: Seen in S-B A0. The engine hands back what the SWF saved with SaveIndices; the shape is the SWF's own.

entries.name: DropItem
entries.evidence: Seen in S-B when dropping an item.

entries.name: AttemptEquip
entries.evidence: Seen in S-B when equipping; also the respond target of CheckForMouseEquip in vanilla and SkyUI.

entries.name: SetButtonMapping
entries.evidence: Sent in every S-B run, no handler: harmless.

entries.name: UpdateItemCardInfo
entries.evidence: S-B A4: works without the card callback and request; the engine never pushes the card unasked. In S-B the card came only as the respond answer to RequestItemCardInfo.
entries.notes: Info fields seen: name, type, value, weight, count, stolen, effects, armor, armorChange, damage, damageChange, charge, usedCharge, poisoned, skillText.

entries.name: AttemptChargeItem
entries.evidence: Registered by vanilla and SkyUI; not seen in S-B.

entries.name: ItemRotating
entries.evidence: Registered by vanilla and SkyUI; cosmetic; not seen in S-B.

entries.name: ToggleMenuFade
entries.evidence: Registered by vanilla and SkyUI; not seen in S-B.

entries.name: PlaySound
entries.evidence: Made in S-B; IDs in vanilla: UIMenuBladeOpenSD, UIMenuBladeCloseSD, UIMenuFocus, UIMenuPrevNext.

entries.name: UpdateItem3D
entries.evidence: Made in S-B; shows the 3D model of the selected item.

entries.name: RequestItemCardInfo
entries.evidence: Made in S-B; answered through respond with the item info object (S-B A4: the card is optional).

entries.name: ItemSelect
entries.evidence: Made in S-B when equipping (the engine acts on list.selectedIndex).
entries.notes: Without it nothing can be equipped or used (inferred).

entries.name: ItemDrop
entries.evidence: Made in S-B when dropping.
entries.notes: Without it nothing can be dropped (inferred).

entries.name: SaveIndices
entries.evidence: Made in S-B on close; the engine hands the array back through RestoreIndices.

entries.name: CloseTweenMenu
entries.evidence: Made in S-B on close.

entries.name: CloseMenu
entries.evidence: Made in S-B on close.
entries.notes: The SWF closes itself (Tab is handled in AS), so without it the menu cannot be closed from the UI (draft, inferred).

entries.name: CheckForMouseEquip
entries.evidence: Vanilla and SkyUI; answered through respond (AttemptEquip). Not seen in S-B.
